name: Non-Verbal
ability: Communicating without using real words. Gestures, noises, and pointing all count as non-verbal. Player names can be used when playing online.

name: Am I Man or Muppet?
ability: If a Townsfolk is turned into a Human they are not informed of this. If a Human is turned into a Townsfolk they are not told of the change, and they become the Townsfolk they believe themselves to be.

name: Big Bird
ability: You are the tallest player.
flavor: Show your true colours. Mine is yellow.

name: Cookie Monster
ability: All players must share their snacks with you.
flavor: No cry because cookie is finished. Smile because cookie happened.

name: Count von Count
ability: You conduct and count each vote.
flavor: One. AH AH AH. Two. AH AH AH.

name: Bunsen Honeydew
ability: You start knowing how many characters are in play that can create Humans.
flavor: Science has left me a sad and lonely man.

name: Rowlf the Dog
ability: You start knowing 2 players who are not Townsfolk.
flavor: Why does everyone always blame dogs?
firstNightReminder: Point to two players with the *Not Townsfolk* token.

name: Pepe the Prawn
ability: You start knowing which Demons are in play.
flavor: I am not a shrimp – I am a king prawn, okay!

name: Sam the Eagle
ability: Each night, you learn how many steps from you to an alive evil player. [+1 Human]
flavor: At times like these, I am proud to be an American.

name: Kermit the Frog
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): a Human, if chosen, becomes a Townsfolk.
flavor: It's nice to be important, but it's important to be nice.
otherNightReminder: Kermit picks a player. If Kermit selected a Human, remove the *Human* reminder token from the player. If Miss Piggy is in play, instead add a *Human* reminder token to the chosen player.

name: Camilla the Chicken
ability: Each night*, if a player died by execution today: you learn a player of their alignment.
flavor: BAWK BAWK BAWK! BAWK BAWK.
otherNightReminder: Point to a player of the same alignment as the player with the *Executed Today* reminder token.

name: Sweetums
ability: Each night*, you learn how many evil players voted today.
flavor: Excuse me Mr. Price, can I give you a hand? (takes off hand)

name: Swedish Chef
ability: Each night*, you learn if there are more or less Humans than last night. If you were non-verbal on the 1st day, you instead learn how many Humans are in play.
flavor: Herdy dur shur floompty. Bort, bort, bort!
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal (up, down, or level; or a number if there is a *Non-verbal* reminder token).

name: The Great Gonzo
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: if you choose a Minion they die, if you choose a Townsfolk you die.
flavor: Tonight ladies and gentlemen, I will eat this rubber tire to the music of The Flight of the Bumblebee...music, maestro!
otherNightReminder: Gonzo chooses a player. If a Minion is chosen, the Minion dies. If a Townsfolk is chosen, Gonzo dies.

name: Rizzo the Rat
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are killed by the Demon tonight, you learn an alive character.
flavor: He died?! And this is supposed to be a kids movie!
otherNightReminder: Rizzo chooses a player. Wake them again if that player dies tonight, and show an in-play alive character token.

name: Fozzie Bear
ability: Each day, you may make a public joke. Wocka! Wocka! Tonight, you learn if it was true.
flavor: Did I tell you the one about the man with the light bulb in his nose? He was lightheaded! Get it? Wocka Wocka!
otherNightReminder: Nod if a *True* reminder token was placed today.

name: Beaker
ability: If you were non-verbal on the 1st day, that night you learn the characters of players who were non-verbal (up to 4) & one character which is not in play.
flavor: Meep meep meep!

name: Dr. Teeth
ability: If the Demon kills you, a Human becomes a Townsfolk: you learn who.
flavor: This staccato tune is posolutely, most transparently bringing me down!
otherNightReminder: If Dr. Teeth was killed by the demon tonight, remove the *Human* reminder token from a player, then point them to the player.

name: Long John Silver
ability: Each night*, one player who voted on you that day might die, even if you are dead.
flavor: Upstage, lads. This is my only number!
otherNightReminder: If Long John Silver was nominated today, one of the players who voted on them might die tonight.

name: Scrooge
ability: Each night, if a player chooses another player, they might target you instead.
flavor: Who was the wretched man whose death brought so much glee and happiness to others?

name: Cameraman
ability: If you communicate verbally on the 1st day, a Townsfolk might become Human immediately.

name: Human
ability: You do not know you are a Human. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
flavor: Am I a man? Or am I a Muppet?
otherNightReminder: Treat them as if they were the character they think they are, but human.

name: Crazy Harry
ability: Each night*, choose a player: the 1st Outsider you choose becomes evil. [+1 Outsider]
flavor: Heh, heh—Did somebody say… BOMB!?
firstNightReminder: Crazy Harry selects a player. The first time they select an Outsider, the Outsider turns evil. Wake the Outsider up and inform them of their new alignment.
otherNightReminder: Crazy Harry selects a player. The first time they select an Outsider, the Outsider turns evil. Wake the Outsider up and inform them of their new alignment.

name: Constantine
ability: Each night*, you may choose 2 players (not a Demon): they swap characters but their abilities do not refresh.
flavor: My name will go down as the greatest thief of all time!
otherNightReminder: Constantine selects two players (not the demon). Swap character tokens of the two chosen players. Wake each swapped player, show them the *YOU ARE* info token and their new character token. Do not refresh abilities.

name: Animal
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die. If you were non-verbal on the 1st day, one of their Townsfolk neighbours becomes Human.
flavor: BEAT DRUMS! BEAT DRUMS!
otherNightReminder: Does Animal want to use it? If yes, Animal chooses a player. That player dies. If Animal has a *Non-Verbal* reminder token, add a *Human* reminder token to one of the Townsfolk neighbours of the chosen target.

name: Scooter
ability: If there are 5 or more players alive, once per day, you may choose to take a player off the block.
flavor: (Holds the clapboard the wrong way) Okay, Muppet Movie, Scenery 1A, Take One!

name: Miss Piggy
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk chosen by Kermit the Frog might become Humans instead. [+ Kermit the Frog]
flavor: Women are like bacon, they smell good, they probably taste good, and they will kill you slowly.
otherNightReminder: Miss Piggy chooses a player. They die.

name: Uncle Deadly
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk who nominate you become Human immediately.
flavor: I swore I would never perform here again, nor would anyone else. I will drive you all from this theatre. LEAVE OR BE DOOOOOOOOOMED!
otherNightReminder: Uncle Deadly chooses a player. They die.

name: Statler
ability: Each night*, wake with Waldorf, together choose one player: they die. [+ Waldorf, -1 Minion]
flavor: Nope, they're ALL bad!
otherNightReminder: Wake with Waldorf: Choose a player. They die.

name: Waldorf
ability: Each night*, wake with Statler, together choose one player: they die. [+ Statler]
flavor: They aren't half bad.
otherNightReminder: Wake with Statler: Choose a player. They die.
